sections.sectionSummaryBrief: The time for the Chanukah light is until the foot of the Tarmudai is consumed, referring to those who rebel against the kingdom of heaven, and through the Chanukah light this consumption is achieved in two senses.

translations.translation: And this is that the time of the Chanukah light is until the foot of the Tarmudai is consumed,
Tarmudai are those who rebel against the kingdom of heaven
(Tarmud is the letters of "rebellious"),
And through the Chanukah light, the consumption of the foot of the Tarmudai is effected,
There are two explanations of this,
That the light of the Chanukah light consumes and nullifies the foot of the Tarmudai,
And that the light of the Chanukah light effects consumption
(consumption from the term "consumption" and "yearning of the soul")
Also in the foot of the Tarmudai,
That even those who were rebellious will come to a state of yearning of the soul.
And this is the superiority of the refinement through the revelation of the Chanukah light over the refinement through the revelation that shone in the days of Shlomo,
That in the days of Shlomo only those sparks that had some aspect of light were refined,
And not the sparks that were darkened
[And certainly
the sparks that are in Tarmud
the letters of "rebellious" were not refined then].
And through the revelation of the Chanukah light, consumption is effected
(yearning of the soul)
Also in the foot of the Tarmudai.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: From this it is understood regarding the spreading of the wellsprings outward, that even those in the lowest external state, including rebellion, are nullified and transformed into yearning of the soul.

translations.translation: And from this it is understood regarding the matter of the spreading of the wellsprings outward,
That even those who are in the most degraded state of "outward,"
Including also the matter of rebellion, G-d forbid,
Through the spreading of the wellsprings outward,
The entire existence of the rebellion that was in them previously is nullified
(Even the foot of the Tarmudai,
For "foot" is the most ultimate level),
And beyond this,
There is effected in them the matter of consumption,
Yearning of the soul.
And analogous to how it will be in the future,
That then "the spirit of impurity I will remove from the earth"
And beyond this – then
"I will turn to the peoples [a pure language] to serve Him with one accord."
